examples.en: I sold my car on eBay to a man in Wisconsin.
examples.zh: 我在亿贝网上把我的小汽车卖给了威斯康星的一位男士。

examples.en: The company teamed up with Wisconsin-based rancher Northstar Bison.
examples.zh: 该公司与威斯康星州的牧场主北极星野牛合作。

examples.en: "You can't say keg party at Arizona State is much better than bar crawl at the University of Wisconsin," he explained.
examples.zh: “你不能说亚利桑那州立大学的 keg party 就比威斯康辛大学 bar crawl 好很多。”他解释说。
